{"evidence":[{"sentence_id":0,"text":"With over 250 members, the Oregon State University Marching Band, (\"OSUMB\"), is the marching band of Oregon State University, known as the \"\"Spirit and Sound of OSU\".\"","title":"Oregon State University Marching Band"},{"sentence_id":1,"text":" It was founded in 1891 making it the oldest band in the Pac-12.","title":"Oregon State University Marching Band"},{"sentence_id":2,"text":" The Oregon State University Marching Band is the primary athletic band at Oregon State.","title":"Oregon State University Marching Band"},{"sentence_id":3,"text":" In addition to the Oregon State University Marching Band, other athletic bands include Basketball Band, Rhythm & Beavs, Rhythm & Beavs: Travel Band, the Away Game Pep Band (for select away games), Alumni Band (the band that covers any games occurring prior to the start of the school term), Gymnastics Band (the ensemble that performs at home gymnastic meets; this ensemble also include alumni members), and Bar Band (a small ensemble that tours local bars on the day before a home football game).","title":"Oregon State University Marching Band"},{"sentence_id":4,"text":" All band members are required to participate in marching band before they may be eligible to participate in any of the other bands Oregon State offers.","title":"Oregon State University Marching Band"},{"sentence_id":0,"text":"The Cal Poly Mustang Band, also known as The Pride of the Pacific, is the official marching band of California Polytechnic State University in the city of San Luis Obispo, California.","title":"Mustang Band"},{"sentence_id":1,"text":" Although the band is not a competitive marching band they serve as a school spirit organization.","title":"Mustang Band"},{"sentence_id":2,"text":" The band functions in two different forms throughout the year.","title":"Mustang Band"},{"sentence_id":3,"text":" In the fall the band marches as The Mustang Marching Band and during Cal Poly's winter quarter they function as a pep band.","title":"Mustang Band"},{"sentence_id":4,"text":" The band attends many athletic events during the year to encourage the school's athletic teams and audience support/involvement.","title":"Mustang Band"},{"sentence_id":5,"text":" The marching band is well-known around campus as an exciting and spirited group that brings pep, passion, and tradition to every performance.","title":"Mustang Band"},{"sentence_id":6,"text":" The marching band is conducted by three directors: Andrew McMahan (Director of Bands), Christopher Woodruff (Associate Director), and Len Kawamoto (Assistant Director).","title":"Mustang Band"}],"peer_messages":["Unverified peer answer: noanswer"],"previous_answer":"noanswer","question":"What city in what state has a nickname of Queen City and a high school with a marching band known as the Marching Blues?"}
